reviews.classification: Full current rulebook plus historical tool/runtime claims and proposed extensions
reviews.disposition: Read complete408lines, recovering truncated dense WA34–48 rows separately. Preserve exact adoption ranges, unknown/claimed/state distinctions, bounded pack proof, later canon/developer policy, shared-seam direction and proposed source-gap family without blanket uptake.
reviews.evidence: Full local body read; current WA register and AD49/51/52 rows inspected. No source novels, private ledgers, tooling, current runtime or historical test rerun.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B342: complete owner, exact uptake and evidence limits
folds.body:
All408 original lines were reviewed: WA1–WA68, implementation claims, every WAC/WO/WAL row, cross-audit application and P2 outcome. Dense WA34–WA48 rows lost to output truncation were reopened explicitly before full credit. The current rules-register row was checked: WA1–WA41, WA48–WA50 and WA54–WA60 have the specific adoption/standing direction recorded there; WA42–WA47, WA51–WA53 and WA61–WA68 retain proposal status. AD49's calibrated-lore direction adopts its stated outcome, not every utility formula, field, conformance test or pilot measurement in WA42–WA47. The old cross-audit sentence referring to WA as proposed is dated history, not the present authority state (AD32).

Current AD51 qualifies any reading of WA1/WA20/WAL13 that requires multiple implemented consumers before a first useful shared seam. Known worlds can justify designing that seam now; a second different world validates or revises it. A truly local mechanism can remain local, and shared laws must not flatten meaningful world differences under AD46. WA6's existing slice exception and the cross-audit note prevent requiring the whole kit floor before every selected function. Fixed K/record/daily-draw budgets and WO scheduling caps describe authoring/runtime work boundaries, not in-world population, play-length or valid-action limits. Retain and continue real work rather than silently truncating it or prohibiting a fictional act.

WA25–WA41 retain their adopted scope and later qualifications. The lead's own canon run pins the source chain while state matches; an outcome reached by different choreography is not automatically equivalent in that selected run. Ordinary lives and later open runs do not inherit every lock. A repeated event can suggest a loop, but the old twice/habit threshold is a default, not evidence of an unspecified schedule or reward. A one-time source grant, gift or chance encounter can legitimately produce progression when its actual mechanism does. Meaningful talk has real consequences, while harmless small talk or texture need not acquire an invented trust meter or payment. AD52 compresses routine while preserving real decisions, costs, time/order, participants, outcomes and noticed evidence.

Source facts, narrator/speaker claims, uncertain translations, authored fills and present character knowledge stay distinct. Mentioned does not mean met, placed does not mean runtime reachable, and a claimed address is not true whereabouts. WA22's own unknown-location exception remains; do not invent a plane/address to satisfy M1. Event time, source order, era windows and revelation order are not interchangeable, especially with loops or flashbacks. A later anchor constrains authored filler in its declared continuity, not a player intervention that genuinely changes the causes. Alias resolution must not expose a hidden identity merely because author records join the names. Implied workers differ from source-mentioned individuals.

WA31's schema/grade reuse rule does not override WPR2/WPR19 or the pipeline's instruction to reopen consequential, conflicting or changed claims. A structural lint, unchanged hash or compatible schema can preserve input identity without establishing semantic truth. WA48's full-known-trajectory sample and sibling-book pressures inform the seam, not earlier-era data or a claim of a new full-source read. A one-volume work can still have consequential late mechanisms; the sample-size dial is not permission to ignore them. A wiki/synthesis fallback remains labelled inference and cannot certify the selected source. WA49's classifier counts and family table retain their actual gap-map dispositions, not proof of mechanics merely because several books share a label.

The proposed WA61–WA68 family usefully preserves gap class/heuristic, exact page/source, model-read layer, medium/edition and calibration uncertainty. Model OCR, art-only presumptions, side stories and secondary-only ledgers cannot patch an exact missing manga page by implication. A flagged page can matter to one anchor while unrelated clean anchors remain usable. A clean extraction does not itself establish claim support or accurate interpretation. Source gap detectors, held ranges and reported JJK/Bleach/Naruto/HP layers are the dated November3 snapshot, not current library or reading state. This review did not open images, PDFs, corpora or a new text layer.

The world-pack lint/fingerprint/coverage and Cyoria P2 claims are historical reported evidence, not a fresh current-source read or executed journey. Byte-identical export definitions do not by themselves prove native behavior or persistence. The P2 outcome explicitly left save revision pinning undone; a fingerprint notice cannot supply missing migration or retain an old generator/template. Current chosen runtime and source inputs determine whether old gaps remain. Proposed pack-diff/rollback tools and WO10's revision-two prerequisite do not become new universal delivery gates. WAC5's old reset permission is confined to its dated old-save deferral and contract; it grants no right to touch real private saves or discard new committed state.

Lazy generation must preserve causally committed world facts even if not yet observed. Freeze-on-reveal is not permission to reroll unseen stock already purchased, transmitted, consumed or used by an NPC. Pack content, runtime truth, evidence ledger and observer projection have different roles; a read model must not become a second truth owner. A dependency's actual function can be absent, unknown, unsupported or genuinely ineligible; those meanings must not collapse into a fabricated world-law rejection. Plain JSON data still needs real readers and settlement. No pack lint proves every source fact, author-declared tier, natural route, alternate seat or full world.

The historical performance sizes, polling intervals, SCC counts, model/shard budgets and stopped lanes keep their original dates. No tool, reader or conversion was launched here. Current desktop direction and AD36/AD43 govern a selected runtime proof; generic human review stays optional under AD42. No WA range, rule text, accepted product direction, world order, source qualification, runtime, pack conversion, save or gameplay result was changed by this full owner review.

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
